newsitem.title: USA: Connecticut healthcare providers in merger.
newsitem.headline: Connecticut healthcare providers in merger.

text.p: Masonicare Inc., Connecticut's biggest non-profit provider of healthcare to the elderly, said Wednesday it has acquired Homecare Inc., the state's largest provider of home health services.
The terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
Wallingford-based Homecare has $25 million in revenues, 1,600 employees and eight patient service offices in the state, Masonicare said in a statement.
The acquisition boosts Masonicare's revenues to $85 million and makes it Connecticut's biggest provider of home healthcare, Masonicare said.
Masonicare's work force is now more than 2,800.
Homecare Inc. offers skilled nursing services, physical, speech and occupational therapies, maternal and newborn care and other services.
The Connecticut homecare industry exceeds $450 million in revenues a year, Masonicare said.
